verdict: Robinhood's revenue rose 36% to $637M as options and crypto trading surged — and with costs down 10% from a year ago, it swung from an $85M loss to a $150M profit.

kpis.label: Net deposits
kpis.note: 29% annualized growth vs assets under custody

segments.name: Transaction-based revenues
segments.note: Fees from customers' trades — options $202M, crypto $61M, equities $37M and $19M of other trading fees.

segments.name: Net interest revenues
segments.note: Interest on customers' cash and margin loans, plus securities lending — up on growth in interest-earning assets.

segments.name: Other revenues
segments.note: Mostly Robinhood Gold subscriptions — 2.2M subscribers, up 65%.

opex.name: Operations
opex.note: Customer support and running the service.

opex.name: Provision for credit losses
opex.note: Money set aside for customer loans that may not be repaid.

opex.name: Marketing
opex.note: Advertising and promotions to win new customers — up 111%.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Legal, finance and head office — down 42% from a year ago.

otherDetail: Other income, net was $2M — small next to the main business. Income tax was just $3M, because Robinhood still carried a valuation allowance against most of its deferred tax assets (released the following quarter).
footerNote: Robinhood does not report a separate cost of revenue; 'Brokerage and transaction' — the direct cost of executing customers' trades — is shown as the direct cost here. Expense lines are as re-presented in Robinhood's Q3 2025 Form 10-Q, which splits the provision for credit losses out of operations.
follow100Note: Trading supplied $50.08 of every $100 of revenue — options alone were $31.71 of it ($202M of $637M).

takeaways.title: Trading revenue surged
takeaways.text: Transaction-based revenue rose 72% to $319M — options revenue grew 63% to $202M, crypto jumped 165% to $61M and equities rose 37% to $37M, as customers traded actively across asset classes.

takeaways.title: A swing to profit
takeaways.text: Net income was $150M versus an $85M loss a year ago: revenue rose 36% while total operating expenses fell 10%, with general & administrative costs down 42%. The tax bill was just $3M — most deferred tax assets still sat under a valuation allowance.

takeaways.title: Gold subscribers climbed 65%
takeaways.text: Robinhood Gold subscribers rose 65% to a record 2.2M, funded customers reached 24.3M, and net deposits were $10.0B in the quarter — a 29% annualized growth rate against assets under custody at the end of Q2.

oneTimers: Reported revenue is after $27M of matches paid to customers on transfers and deposits — an incentive Robinhood nets against revenue (it was $13M in Q2 2024), so the trading growth underneath was slightly stronger than the headline.

The $3M tax provision is unusually small: Robinhood still carried a valuation allowance against most of its deferred tax assets in Q3 2024. It released that allowance the following quarter, booking a one-time $369M tax benefit in Q4 2024.

sources.label: Form 10-Q, quarter ended September 30, 2025 — re-presented 2024 comparatives (SEC EDGAR)
